title: siren fire truck north american distant drive by one block over echo +tree wind hiss
author: kyles
changes: A real North American fire truck sounding its air horn, 'honk-honk-honk', as it drives by a block away. Trimmed to 51.30–54.20 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.3 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Sony PCM-D50). The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency traffic rumble.
